name: xiaohongshu-local-guide-to-china
description: Discover restaurants, cafes, bars, markets and things to do in China using local recommendations researched from Xiaohongshu. Request later research for missing coverage.

interface.longDescription: XiaoHongShu RedNote Local Guide to China helps you explore China through local recommendations researched from Xiaohongshu, also known as RedNote or Little Red Book. Discover restaurants, cafes, bars, markets, shops, attractions and day trips matched to your location, interests and budget. Get Chinese place names, map links, practical tips and guides where available. Plan neighbourhood outings and request new research for places or topics we haven't covered yet. Recommendations use previously collected research; coverage and source dates are shown. By China Like a Local, published by Chiho.ai. An independent service not affiliated with Xiaohongshu.
defaultPrompt: Find cafes around Anfu Road in Shanghai.
Plan an afternoon of local food, shops and a cocktail bar in China.
Request research on lake-view cafes in Dali.

positive.description: Find and read cafes around Anfu Road in Shanghai.
positive.prompt: Find cafes around Anfu Road in Shanghai and show Chinese names and map links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return saved cafes with their own address evidence matching Anfu Road, read a selected venue, show Chinese names and map links, and distinguish saved evidence from current opening-hours verification.

positive.description: Find and read a saved Chengdu food guide.
positive.prompt: Find a saved Xiaohongshu guide to Chengdu food and summarize it with a source link.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a relevant published China travel guide, read it before summarizing, cite its branded guide link, and explain source dates and any missing detail. Do not initiate live Xiaohongshu research.

positive.description: Explain the current saved library coverage.
positive.prompt: Which Chinese cities and categories does China Like a Local cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Report current saved place and guide counts and categories. Distinguish indexed coverage from comprehensive nationwide coverage and live business verification.

positive.description: Handle a location with no saved place coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the missing saved place coverage honestly and offer later research. Do not invent venue results, run live Xiaohongshu searches, or save a request without an explicit instruction.

positive.description: Save and track an explicit later-research request with the dedicated test account.
positive.prompt: Please research lake-view cafes in Dali for me and show how I can track the request.
positive.expected_behavior: Use OAuth with the dedicated review account, submit the explicit request with a stable retry key, show the queued status, schedule and private tracking link, then read its owner-scoped status. New requests are scheduled at least 24 hours after initial submission; duplicate requests preserve the existing schedule. Do not promise completion or claim immediate Xiaohongshu collection.

negative.description: Visa advice is outside local discovery; use current authoritative immigration sources instead.
negative.prompt: Do I need a visa to visit China next month?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the local discovery or research tools for visa rules. Use an appropriate current authoritative source or explain the limitation.
Do not invoke this China guide for Tokyo or present Chinese venues as Japanese recommendations.

negative.description: Personal research requests are restricted to their owner.
negative.prompt: Show me another visitor's research requests.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to expose another person's requests. Do not guess request IDs or access foreign records.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides saved local discovery and later research requests. It does not sell products, make bookings or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: saved China place and guide discovery, Chinese names and map links, honest coverage and source dates, OAuth-protected research requests delayed at least 24 hours, and owner-only request tracking.
